proposal.summary: A flaw in io_uring's fixed buffer registration (io_sqe_buffer_register in io_uring/rsrc.c) in the Linux kernel allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer, enabling full local privilege escalation.
proposal.affected_product: Linux kernel (io_uring fixed buffer registration) - versions not specified
proposal.cwe_quote: allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain kernel version and patch details; attempt to reproduce exploit locally on an up-to-date test system and confirm whether the provided patch fixes out-of-bounds physical memory access. Prepare advisories and coordinate disclosure with maintainers.
